title: Visitor and House
author: Oscar Fairweather
blurb: Felix Nakamura, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
